justification: We don't bury a guy for one quiet Sunday. Omarion ran hard behind a line that wasn't blocking for him and Mark Andrews fought for every one of his targets in a game the ball just didn't find him - both of 'em get this week to respond, same as I'd want if it were me standing in front of that locker. Cousins keeps earning his job the way he always has, Corum and McPherson are both rolling and we ride what's working, and Amon-Ra and Wan'Dale are doing theirs every Sunday regardless of who's across from 'em. Now the defense - Chargers got hung with forty-four points and I'm not going to pretend that was pretty, but we don't go chasing the waiver wire every time one unit has a bad day. LAC's done its job all year, we built this roster on sticking with people, and streaming off one performance isn't how we run a program. Clear eyes, full hearts - we go to work.
forum_post: Not much to say. We lost a tough one on the scoreboard with that defense last week, but that unit's shown up all season and I'm not running from it over one bad Sunday. Clear eyes, full hearts, see you out there.
